newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Fitzwilton ups Waterford Wedgwood stake.
newsitem.headline: Fitzwilton ups Waterford Wedgwood stake.

text.p: Irish industrial holding group Fitzwilton Plc on Tuesday said it has exercised an option to buy Morgan Stanley's remaining stake in Shuttleway for 23 million Irish pounds ($35.4 million).
Fitzwilton said in a statement that it has informed Waterford Wedgwood Plc that this gives it a further holding of 26.5 million Waterford Wedgwood shares.
This brings Fitzwilton's total shareholding in the crystal and fine china group to 119.66 million or 16.4 percent of the equity in the group.
It said through Shuttleway's holding it now has voting control of more than 19.94 percent of Waterford.
H.J. Heinz Co chief, Irish entrepreneur Tony O'Reilly is chairman of both Fitzwilton and Waterford Wedgwood.
